Canvas Print Description

A statement piece such as the print, "How Far Is a Light Year?", can be a bold accent for your home or office. This work by Alexander Grahovsky takes pop art to a different level. The image depicts a beautiful person with smooth ebony skin, wearing pale blue sunglasses and blowing a bright pink bubble. This eye-catching piece brilliantly captures a single moment in time.
